link.label: Paste a pipeline, MR, run or PR link

empty.title: Add your first project
empty.text: Paste a GitLab or GitHub repository link or pick a folder with a clone.

addProject.title: Add project
addProject.placeholder: https://gitlab.example.com/group/project, https://github.com/owner/repo or a folder path
addProject.hint: A repository, pipeline, MR, run or PR link works.
addProject.findOnHost: Find in the host's project list

token.scope: Personal Access Token with the read_api scope.
token.scopeGithub: Fine-grained token with Actions: read and Contents: read permissions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.linuxHint: On Linux the token is stored in Secret Service (gnome-keyring, KWallet). Without it, use glab or the GITLAB_TOKEN and GITLAB_HOST variables.

report.loadFailed: Failed to read the report data: {{detail}}
report.needsMissing: Job dependencies are unavailable: no access to the workflow file. One stage, the critical path follows timing only.

keys.zoom: <k>⌘</k>/<k>Ctrl</k> + wheel or pinch — zoom around the cursor, horizontal swipe — pan, <k>0</k> — the whole pipeline
keys.stage: Click a stage — critical path to its end
keys.job: Click a job — its links, <k>Esc</k> — clear the selection

hotspots.title: Where to focus
hotspots.excess: stage <n>{{stage}}</n> waits {{excess}} for it after the others
hotspots.excessCritical: stage <n>{{stage}}</n> waits {{excess}} for it after the others, on the critical path

verdict.stagePath: The critical path to the end of the stage is highlighted in the waterfall.
verdict.pipelinePath: The critical path is highlighted in the waterfall.
verdict.off: Not on the critical path: speeding it up will not shorten the pipeline.
verdict.on: On the critical path: speeding it up will shorten the pipeline.
verdict.onAgg: On the critical path in {{percent}}% of pipelines: speeding it up will shorten the pipeline.
verdict.onAggSometimes: On the critical path in {{percent}}% of pipelines: speeding it up sometimes shortens the pipeline.
verdict.retriesAgg: Worth a look at the retries — {{retried}} of {{present}}.

input.title: What goes here
input.text: A link to a repository, pipeline or MR, an ssh address, or a folder with a clone — the button on the right.

create.title: A token is needed
create.text: The link opens the token page with the right scopes preset. The token is kept in the system keychain.

screen.title: One pipeline or many
screen.text: Click a pipeline to build its report. The aggregate combines N pipelines of the branch and shows p50 and p90.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.text: On GitHub, runs and the aggregate are built for one workflow — pick it here.

link.title: A shortcut
link.text: Next time, paste a pipeline, MR, run or PR link here — the report builds without opening the project.

hotspots.title: Where to start
hotspots.text: Only critical path jobs are listed: speeding up others won't shorten the pipeline. Click to jump to the job.

critical.title: Orange is the critical path
critical.text: These jobs set the pipeline length. Click a stage to recompute the path up to its end.

keys.title: Zoom and keys
keys.text: ⌘/Ctrl + wheel zooms, [ and ] pan, 0 shows the whole pipeline. The rest is under “?”.

retries.title: Retries
retries.text: Red hatching marks failed attempts. The label ↻2 −8m29s shows how many there were and the time lost on them.

aggregate.title: Reading the aggregate
aggregate.text: The bar is the p50 start and duration, the line after it reaches p90. The label on the right is the share of runs with retries.

detail.title: Details panel
detail.text: At the top is the verdict: whether speeding this up shortens the pipeline. Links ↑/↓ are below. Esc clears the selection.
